### What is the average temperature in August
The average temperature in Mumbai in August for a typical day ranges from a high of 83°F (28°C) to a low of 77°F (25°C).Some would describe the temperature to be very warm. The general area may also feel slightly windy.

...

### How much does it rain in August
In Mumbai in August, there's a 81% chance of rain on an average day. And on the average day it rains or snows, we get 0.61 in (15.6 mm) of precipitation. In more common terms of how much that is, some would describe it as moderate rain.

...

### How windy is it in August
Historically, the wind in Mumbai during August blows at an average speed of 15.9 mph (25.6 kph). The windiest month is July with an average wind speed of 17.5 mph (28.2 kph), while the calmest month is October with an average wind speed of 9.2 mph (14.8 kph).
This graph shows the average wind speed in Mumbai in August based on historical data.
Average monthly wind speed in Mumbai

...

### Where does this data come from
For all data based on historical data, we've averaged the data from the past 11 years (2010-2020). For example, for the hourly temperature at 10am, we've looked at the temperature at 10am on every day in August (e.g., August 1, August 2, etc. in 2010, 2011, etc.) and took the arithmetic mean.
We did not smooth the data, so for example, our daily temperature line will have some randomness due to the fact that weather is random in the first place.

### August
The weather in August is almost identical to July. Towards the latter half of the month, rainfall activity tends to lessen. The coolest days of the monsoon season are often in August. The max temperature might drop to 29.3 °C during the day and 24.5 °C at night. [[ 11 ]]()
